metadata.title: Amazon and Uber Want to Bring You Your Next Meal. The Delivery Turf War Is Escalating.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Amazon and Uber Want to Bring You Your Next Meal. The Delivery Turf War Is Escalating.
Just when you thought online grocery delivery news had peaked this month, Amazon.com and Uber have entered the ring, escalating the food delivery war.
